fieldDescription: Steers the fleet while it flies itself to a planet, star, jump point, gate or star system. Stations, fleets and other objects are never steered. A held mouse button, the go-slow key, Sensor Burst or Interdiction Pulse hands control back for that moment.
Moves slowly inside and ahead of storming or signaling cells, then resumes burn. Slow-moving fleets are not struck.
Goes around a storm on the way to the target when the detour is short enough. Otherwise moves slowly through it.

fieldName: Storm detour limit (percent of the leg)
fieldDescription: Longest detour around a storm, as a percent of the distance to the target.
After leaving a slipstream, accelerates against the sideways speed first and turns back to the target at once.
Enters a nearby slipstream that flows toward the target and saves time, and leaves it where the trip is shortest.
Largest angle between the slipstream's flow and the direction to the target for entering it.
Enters a slipstream only when the trip takes at least this percent less time.
With the ability: turns Reverse Polarity on before entering or crossing a slipstream that flows away from the target, and off after leaving. Outside a slipstream this costs nothing.
Also turns Reverse Polarity on inside a slipstream that carries the fleet away from the target. Costs fuel and CR as a manual use. Skipped when a ship's CR is below the cost.

Without a usable Reverse Polarity: a slipstream on the way that does not flow toward the target is kept out of. Target on this side: the fleet goes along its edge. Target across: it crosses straight across at a gap or the weakest place near the way, with Sustained Burn off.
Steers around star coronas, black hole event horizons and stars. Pulsar beams are not steered around. A course to a star, a black hole or a point inside a corona stops outside it and ends there.
Extra distance kept from hazards and stars, added to the fleet's radius.

fieldName: Slow down in asteroid belts and fields
fieldDescription: Moves slowly inside asteroid belts and fields, starting at braking distance before them, then resumes burn. Slow-moving fleets take no asteroid impacts.
Steers around hostile fleets that you can see, that can see you and that are stronger than your fleet. Flies straight past weaker ones.
A hostile fleet counts as stronger when its effective strength is above yours times this number.
Distance kept from stronger hostile fleets, added to both fleets' radii.

Turns Sustained Burn on for trips longer than 2000 units and 11 seconds, and back on when the game or another ability turned it off. Also while riding a slipstream with its flow; turned off when leaving it. Not while slowing down, near a slipstream, or with a stronger hostile fleet close by. Turned off by you: left off until the next target.

Jumps into and out of star systems without the jump dialog. The dialog still opens when the game warns of hostile fleets at the exit, when it asks about the transponder, when fuel is short, and for wormholes, unstable jump points and jump points with more than one exit. Fuel is charged as in the dialog.

A laid-in course goes through two gates of one network when that way is at least the percent below and one light year shorter. Gates: once the game offers Travel through the Gate (Janus Device working, At the Gates finished), scanned active gates, and gate beacons as exits only (such as a Random Assortment of Things settlement with a Gate Beacon). The fleet flies to the entry gate, transits without the gate dialog at the game's fuel cost, and the course to the target is laid in again at the exit gate. With hostile fleets near the exit gate or too little fuel there is no transit, and the course to the target is laid in again. Laying in the course to the same target again during a gate route flies direct. Off while the Autopilot With Gates ability is on.

With AoTD Vaults of Knowledge and a Bifrost Control Center on a colony: gate routes also use Bifrost gates that are supplied and not cooling down. A Bifrost transit costs no fuel and puts both gates on a 30-day cooldown, unless a hypershunt powers them.
Uses gates only when the way through them is at least this percent and one light year shorter.
Writes each steering change, the reason when it does not steer, the obstacles found for each target and a status line every 10 seconds to starsector.log. Nothing is shown on screen.
